title: Rethinking Aquaculture Resilience Beyond Species Diversification: Insights From the Lower Mekong Delta With Global Implications
content: Species diversification can support niche adaptation but should be embedded within a broader system-centred strategy. System-level interventions, including feed efficiency, water and salinity management, biosecurity, selective breeding, value chains, governance and conservation consideration, deliver more scalable resilience benefits for aquaculture under climate change and other environmental stressors.
author: Khuong V. Dinh
